text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While preparing for the "Umamusume 
Exchange Event" as part of our community 
outreach with Almond Eye and the others...
choice_data_list: Ah! The information sign is broken...!?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I-It's true! This is serious...! Without 
this, everyone's gonna be in trouble, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... That said, everyone else 
looks pretty busy too—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's make a new one together. 
We've made one for the Holy Hoof Festival 
before, so I'm sure we can do it!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"Wait! Boo wants to hammer the nails! I 
saw a video of humans doing it recently!"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Quickly! But careful not to break it! 
—One, two, three!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! How about that, how about that! I 
drove 'em all in in one shot!
choice_data_list:
That was a stroke of genius, holding back 
just the right amount.

That was a stroke of genius, holding back 
just the right amount.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Not bad, Blast. ...I can't afford to lose 
either!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(Focus on one point. Control my breathing, 
don't tense up too much...)

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! Three in a row! Ai is super amazing, 
you know!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. This is great for controlling my 
physical senses! ...I might even be able 
to apply it to racing!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's keep going at this pace!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—Welcome everyone to the Umamusume 
Exchange Meet! Today's hosts are me, 
Almond Eye, and—!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
The name's Blast Onepiece! Great to 
meetcha today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the two of them, the mixer was a 
complete success... and Almond Eye's 
running was polished even further!
